headline: Tupelo Football Player Killed In Weekend Crash
html:
Tupelo High School football player Alden Wade died in a single-vehicle crash early Sunday, Oct. 11, in Tupelo.

Tupelo police said officers responded at approximately 1:11 a.m. to the 4900 block of Cliff Gookin Boulevard. The crash resulted in one fatality, and department accident reconstructionists responded to investigate.

The police statement did not identify the person who died. WTVA, citing the Lee County Coroner’s Office, identified the victim as Wade.

Tupelo head football coach Ty Hardin remembered Wade for his character and smile.

“No Words. Phenomenal young man with the perfect smile. Definition of a selfless person. You will be missed AW!” Hardin said.

In a statement, Tupelo High School and its football team said they were heartbroken by Wade’s death and expressed support for his family, friends, teammates and classmates.

Police said additional information may be released when appropriate.
excerpt: Tupelo football player Alden Wade died in a single-vehicle crash Sunday, Oct. 11. Police and the school community responded to the loss.
